specs.v: Towers with pointed roofs on a mossy rock
Ornament and hiding place for fish

description.html: In this decoration the rock plays the main role: it is tall, layered and densely covered in green moss, and on top stands a sand-colored castle with towers and pointed roofs. At the base and on the sides of the rock there are openings and caves where fish hide.

Thanks to its height, the decoration nicely fills the back of the aquarium and becomes its centerpiece. The green moss tones tie it to live plants, so it looks more natural than classic colorful castles. The caves in the rock suit fish that like dark hiding places and spend part of the day out of sight.

Before placing it, rinse the decoration in lukewarm water, without soap. Place it in the back of the aquarium on a flat bottom and check that it does not wobble. Make sure it does not block the filter intake and that water can flow around it. Brush algae off the moss and rock with a soft brush, and rinse debris out of the caves during water changes.
